display_long_description:
Take the controls and become a pilot in an immersive VR flight simulator! Experience the thrill of flying an airplane, aeroplane, aircraft or jet from an immersive first-person cockpit.

🛫 FLY LIKE A PILOT
Step into the cockpit, grab the controls and experience airplane flying in virtual reality. Control your aircraft through takeoff, flight, maneuvering, descent and landing.

🛬 MASTER TAKEOFFS & LANDINGS
Take off from airport runways, navigate through the skies and return safely to the airport. Improve your piloting skills and master smooth landings.

✈️ IMMERSIVE AIRCRAFT EXPERIENCE
Look around your cockpit, interact with flight controls and experience the sensation of actually sitting in the pilot's seat. Feel the freedom of flight from a true VR perspective.

🌎 EXPLORE THE SKIES
Take your aircraft into the skies and enjoy immersive flying through beautiful environments while experiencing the world of aviation.

🎮 BUILT FOR VR
Designed around an immersive cockpit experience, this flight simulator puts you directly in control of your airplane.

Whether you're searching for an airplane simulator, aircraft simulator, flight simulator, flying simulator, pilot simulator, aviation game or VR flight game, Flight Simulator: Airplane Pilot VR puts you in the pilot's seat.

Take the controls. Start your flight. Become the pilot.
